title: Love the look - but handle gets too hot
text: Love the look - but handle gets too hot. I really love the look of this kettle.  It is sleek and a great size.  Unfortunately, because of the thickness of the material, the handle and trigger get very hot.  It comes with a kettle holder, but its awkward and would be an easy item to lose.  Although the old time kettle is heavier, I think I will go back to it.
